text:
Maria Lu: Heads-up — APAC (sin1) hit near-OOM on a subset of Dedicated pools around 10:01 UTC, observed heavy KV cache churn and GPU memory pressure.
Zheng Wu: Seeing same, dashboards show GPU mem used ~98% on gpul-batch-08 and continuous KV evictions. Logs show long chat sequences from a single tenant spiking sequence_len > 48k tokens.
Jen (SRE): Incident bot flagged throttles, but autoscaler didn't add nodes — scaling decisions were based on qps not memory. :thinking_face:
Dave O.: We recently lowered forecast uplift for APAC after Q4 — might be underprovisioning. Which tenant? any PII/enterprise?
Zheng Wu: It's a new partner (session-heavy voice transcript use) on Dedicated; not enterprise compliance-sensitive, but sessions kept long-running prompting huge KV growth.
Evan (Product): That partner was onboarded last week, their integration test used short chats only. We missed production session length distribution. My bad.
Maria Lu: Immediate mitigations applied at 10:04 UTC: evict non-essential caches, enable per-session token cap (soft 8k tokens), and route new requests to alternative compatible pools.
capacity-bot: autoscaler_event: suppressed_scale_up because metric_source="qps" threshold_not_met.
Jen (SRE): Root cause candidates: 1) Forecast model used mean session length not 99th pctile, 2) autoscaler policy tied to qps, not GPU memory/KV pressure, 3) routing didn't fallback fast enough to other AZs.
Zheng Wu: Repro steps we used: run perf harness with session length distribution skewed to 90th=24k, 99th=48k; KV cache size grew linearly, memory crossed 95% within ~3m. Snippet: 
```
# synthetic session generator
for i in range(1000):
  send_chunk(tokens=random.randint(20000,48000))
```
Dave O.: Cost note — dedicating extra nodes mid-incident added ~12 GPU-hrs in 30m burst. We'll need to reflect that in next capacity commit.
Evan (Product): Action items from product side: flag new partner onboarding tests to include long-session scenarios, update playbook to require session-length histogram before Dedicated moves.
Jen (SRE): Ops action items: 1) change autoscaler to consider `gpu_mem_percent` and `kv_eviction_rate` as scale-up signals, 2) add admission control per-tenant (soft/ hard caps), 3) implement faster cross-AZ fallback routing, 4) add alert for sustained KV eviction > 30s.
Maria Lu: Forecasting changes: switch to P99 session-length uplift for APAC; add anomaly detector for sudden per-tenant session-length change > 3x baseline.
Zheng Wu: I'll instrument per-tenant KV size and add a histogram export to prometheus (label tenant_id).
Dave O.: For near-term capacity: request +8 GPUs in sin1 pool and enable pre-warm for the partner windows. Finance, pls note one-off.
Evan (Product): Also update onboarding checklist and sample traffic generator in the partner SDK docs.
Jen (SRE): Postmortem owners: Maria (lead), Zheng (tech), Evan (product), Dave (cost). Timeline: triage done, mitigations applied at 10:04 UTC, full stability by 10:18 UTC.
Maria Lu: Thanks everyone. I'll open the formal postmortem doc and link follow-ups. :thumbsup:
